title: config.cloud_enabled payload
description: The state of the cloud flag of the LLM gateway (api-contracts.md 2.3.16, contracts.md C-06 v1.1, ADR-005 addendum p. 3). Published on every start of core, enabled=false included, so that the projection of the gateway is deterministic after a restart. No key, no URL, no secret ever travels here (SEC-21).

provider.description: The name from MV_LLM_PROVIDER, never an address. The prose said "and nothing else" while the type accepted a URL (T-215).

external_players_ack.description: The operator confirmed the flag with external players in the world (UC-030).
